name: Designer Leather Jacket - Premium Edition
description:
Crafted from genuine full-grain leather, this premium jacket combines timeless style with modern comfort. The slim-fit silhouette, quilted lining, and brass YKK zippers make this a wardrobe essential for the discerning gentleman.

**Premium Details:**
- 100% genuine full-grain cowhide leather
- Soft viscose inner lining with quilted padding
- YKK brass zippers with leather pull tabs
- Two exterior and two interior pockets
- Adjustable waist tabs for a custom fit
- Available in Black and Dark Brown
deliveryInfo: Delivery in 2-4 working days across Pakistan
